## Changes since 9.3.0-dzbarsky24

- Preserve packages throughout top-level alias chains when Skymeld discards pre-execution caches. This prevents `ALREADY_DECLARED_CHILD_MISSING` failures with `--notrack_incremental_state` when an alias and its target belong to different packages. Merges [PR #15](https://github.com/dzbarsky/bazel/pull/15), an unchanged cherry-pick of upstream [87b5a04e91a0](https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/commit/87b5a04e91a00ce00f360281f130befb5e73a237).

### Validation

The patched Bazel binary and integration-test target built successfully on Linux x86_64 with remote execution. The upstream `test_skymeld_top_level_alias_notrack_incremental_state` regression passed. Patch identity matches upstream; `git diff --check` and shell syntax checks passed.

### Release publication

This release is immutable and includes Linux and macOS binaries for x86_64 and arm64, with SHA-256 checksums and build-provenance attestations.
